question: In the 2024 Union Budget, the government allocated funds for the development of the Vishnupad Temple Corridor. In which of the following states is the Vishnupad Temple located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bihar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vishnupad Temple was built by Rani Ahilyabai in 1787.
 
• Here are some more details about the Vishnupad Temple:
 
 
• ​The temple is located on the banks of the Phalgu River, about 4 kilometres from Gaya Junction Railway Station and 10 kilometres from Bodhgaya Bus Station.
 
• The temple is built in the Nagara style of architecture. It is a two-story structure with a pyramidal roof.
 
• The main sanctum sanctorum of the temple houses the footprint of Lord Vishnu. The footprint is made of black stone and is about 18 inches long.
 
• The temple complex also has a number of other shrines, including shrines dedicated to Lakshmi, Saraswati, and Hanuman.
 
• The temple is open to devotees from all faiths. It is a popular pilgrimage destination, especially during the पितृपक्ष (Pitru Paksha) festival, when Hindus offer prayers for their ancestors.
